errors.text_span: 这些类别以字母顺序排列
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the categories on the x-axis are arranged in alphabetical order. They are actually arranged in descending order based on their corresponding values on the y-axis.
The description states that the unit for the y-axis is '个' (count/item), but the y-axis has no label or units shown in the figure.
